The following was agreed in RAN1#120 regarding enhancements for NPRACH: Agreement For NPRACH, further consider the two options until RAN1#120bis: Option 1: New NPRACH periodicities (multiple of 90ms) are introduced for NB-IoT NTN TDD. Option 2: NPRACH transmissions are postponed in non-U NB-IoT subframes until the next U NB-IoT subframe(s) FFS: The unit of postponement (e.g. PRU) There seems to be a majority of companies that want to specify both options. On new periodicities, the following has been proposed: [TH], [ZTE], [NOR]: No new periodicities. [HW], [OPPO], [SS], [XMI], [APP], [DCM], [LGE], [LEN], Introduce new periodicities (multiple of 90 ms) On postponement, the following has been proposed: [TH], [vivo], [SPDR], [ZTE], [Iri], [CMCC], [HW], [OPPO], [XMI], [LGE], [QC], [NOR], [CATT]: NPRACH is postponed in non-U NB-IoT subframes with a unit of PRU NOTE: “U NB-IoT subframes” are subframes contained within the set of U=8 usable consecutive uplink subframes in the TDD structure. On UL gaps, the following working assumption was reached in the previous meeting: Working assumption Uplink transmission gaps do not apply in NB-IoT NTN TDD. A clear majority of companies support confirming the working assumption: [TH], [vivo], [SPDR], [Iri], [DCM], [QC], [APP]: Confirm the working assumption Uplink transmission gaps do not apply in NB-IoT NTN TDD.

In RAN1#120, it was agreed that non-U NB-IoT subframes are not considered by the UE as “NB-IoT UL subframes”. However, how to handle the NPRACH on non-U NB-IoT subframes is still pending. Following two options are agreed for further consideration: Option 1: New NPRACH periodicities (multiple of 90ms) are introduced for NB-IoT NTN TDD. Option 2: NPRACH transmissions are postponed in non-U NB-IoT subframes until the next U NB-IoT subframe(s) FFS: The unit of postponement (e.g. PRU) Regarding above options, option 2 can be adopted so that NPRACH repetition transmission can be allowed. Moreover, eNB can utilize the frequency hopping of symbol group to estimate the timing offset. Hence, the unit of postponement should be based on preamble repetition unit (PRU) to keep the complete NPRACH structure. The target of Option 1 is to match the periodicity of NPRACH and TDD pattern, to ensure the start of NPRACH can locate within U subframes. However, after implementing option 2, the start of NPRACH can be postponed to a U subframe even if it originally locates at non-U subframes. Hence, option 1 seems not necessary after adopting option 2. Proposal 6: NPRACH transmissions are postponed in non-U NB-IoT subframes until the next U NB-IoT subframe(s) and the unit of postponement should be preamble repetition unit. Proposal 7: Introduction of new NPRACH periodicities is not necessary after adopting the option to postpone NPRACH transmission in non-U NB-IoT subframes to next U NB-IoT subframes.

(6/10) [Session chair]: Check companies’ understanding (assuming R17 default CBR is configured) Case 1: partial sensing, R17 normal pool, R17 default CBR – partial Case 2a: random selection, R17 normal pool, R17 default CBR – random Case 2b: random selection, R16/17 exceptional pool, R16 default CBR Case 3: full sensing, R16/17 normal pool, R16 default CBR or invalid case? Case 1, 2a, 2b are confirmed. Case 3 will be revisited next meeting. RAN2 further discussed Case-3 above at RAN2#120 yet failed to reach consensus on whether or not it is valid. Therefore, RAN2 kindly requests RAN1 to provide answer to Q1 below. Reply to Q1: From RAN1 perspective, in general when the UE is performing full sensing and the full sensing results are available it is reasonable to expect that it has already CBR measurements. However, since CBR and the full sensing operation are two independent mechanisms and UE capabilities as indicated in TS38.822 it might be possible that CBR measurements under full sensing are not available, and the UE has to rely on a default CBR value. 2. Actions: RAN1 kindly requests RAN2 to take the above information into consideration for their future work. 3. Dates of Next RAN WG1 Meetings: TSG RAN WG1 Meeting #112-bis-e 17 April– 26 April 2023 Online TSG RAN WG1 Meeting #113 22 May– 26 May 2023 Incheon, South Korea

he beginning of the next uplink transmission occasion following the start of a radio frame fulfilling . For NTN IoT TDD mode, NPRACH transmission can start at the beginning of the next uplink transmission occasion after the start of a radio frame fulfilling . As illustrated in the following Figure, nprach-Periodicity =40 should not be configured. Indeed, nprach-Periodicity of 40ms is leading to collision between two NPRACH transmission occasions. Thereby, the minimum nprach-Periodicity is 80ms. RAN1#120 made the following agreement: Agreement For NPRACH, further consider the two options until RAN1#120bis: Option 1: New NPRACH periodicities (multiple of 90ms) are introduced for NB-IoT NTN TDD. Option 2: NPRACH transmissions are postponed in non-U NB-IoT subframes until the next U NB-IoT subframe(s) FFS: The unit of postponement (e.g. PRU) Base on the above discussion, there is no need to introduce NPRACH periodicities (multiple of 90ms) for NB-IoT NTN TDD. The existing configurations for nprach-Periodicity could be still used. Only nprach-Periodicity of 40ms should not be supported. Proposal 11 The existing nprach-Periodicity values can be utilized for NB-IoT NTN TDD, with the exception of the nprach-Periodicity of 40ms, which should be avoided. In our view, NPRACH transmissions are postponed in non-U NB-IoT subframes until the next U NB-IoT subframe(s). Further, as mentioned earlier, one NPRACH preamble repetition unit consists of P symbol groups, transmitted without gaps (G=P). Indeed, the P symbol groups are transmitted in a time contiguous manner to form one preamble transmission i.e., G = 4 for both NPRACH format 0 and 1. With the above in made, we made the following proposal: Proposal 12 NPRACH transmissions are postponed in non-U NB-IoT subframes until the next U NB-IoT subframe(s) The unit of postponement is PRU

{"chunk_id":"R1-2502057-005","collection":"ran1_tdoc_chunks","metadata":{"source":["Iridium Satellite LLC"],"tdocNumber":"R1-2502057","title":"Remaining aspects of loT-NTN TDD mode"},"point_id":"4148722427722313098"}
The UE is permitted to pre-compensate uplink timing only at the start of NPUSCH/NPRACH transmissions or at NPUSCH/NPRACH transmission segment boundaries ]. If the transmission segment boundary falls at the end of the uplink active time, UL timing and frequency pre-compensation should be done at the start of the next uplink active time. In RAN1#120 it is agreed that for the IoT-NTN TDD mode, the non-U NB-IoT subframes are not considered by the UE as “NB-IoT UL subframes”. In IoT-NTN TDD mode, the uplink timing and frequency pre-compensation shall always be done either at the start of the uplink active time or during the uplink active time. This can be achieved by adding text in 36.213 §16.1.2. Proposal 3: In IoT-NTN TDD mode, for any uplink segments not starting in a NB-IoT uplink subframe, time and frequency pre-compensation adjustment is postponed to the start of the next NB-IoT uplink subframe.
